001package org.clafer.collection;
002
003import java.util.Comparator;
004import org.clafer.common.Check;
005
006/**
007 *
008 * @param <T> the type of objects that may be compared by this comparator
009 * @author jimmy
010 */
011public class ChainedComparator<T> implements Comparator<T> {
012
013    private final Comparator<T>[] comparators;
014
015    @SafeVarargs
016    public ChainedComparator(Comparator<T>... comparators) {
017        this.comparators = Check.noNulls(comparators);
018    }
019
020    @Override
021    public int compare(T o1, T o2) {
022        for (Comparator<T> comparator : comparators) {
023            int compare = comparator.compare(o1, o2);
024            if (compare != 0) {
025                return compare;
026            }
027        }
028        return 0;
029    }
030}
